evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/a directly extends org.pushingpixels.substance.api.SubstanceLookAndFeel and contains only one constructor.
Its constructor creates the already-owned R22 rs/gui/b RuneLiteSkin and passes that instance directly to the SubstanceLookAndFeel superclass constructor.
Historical RuneLite/OpenOSRS source defines net.runelite.client.ui.skin.SubstanceRuneLiteLookAndFeel with the same superclass and constructor pattern around RuneLiteSkin.
